messages:
devon: Hey @support, we started seeing failures this morning when using response_format=\"json\" and strict=true. Client gets a parse error from our side. devon: Repro (minimal): ```bash curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \ -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ -d '{"prompt":"hi","response_format":"json","strict":true}' ``` devon: Response was a 500 and the body isn't JSON. Request-ID: 7f9c2a alex: Sorry about that — can you paste the full response body and any response headers you got? Also your org/team name so I can look up logs. devon: Org: acme-apps. Full response body (trimmed): ```html Internal Server Error

500 Internal Server Error

Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/srv/runtime/handler.py\", line 42, in handle_request\n    ...\n
``` Headers: ``` Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 X-Request-ID: 7f9c2a ``` alex: Ugh, that explains the parse error — the runtime returned an HTML error page even though the request asked for JSON. I'm escalating to eng and creating an internal ticket. In the meantime, can you try setting `Accept: application/json` in your request as a temporary workaround? Also removing strict will avoid the client error but obviously isn't ideal. maya: I just pulled the deploy notes — we shipped a small change this morning to surface nicer HTML error pages from the control plane for internal-only errors. That inadvertently changed content negotiation for 5xx responses. If a client asked for JSON we should still return our error JSON schema; looks like we missed that branch. maya: Short-term mitigation: If you include `Accept: application/json` the control plane routes to the JSON error renderer. Long term: rolling a tiny hotfix to ensure any request with `response_format=\"json\"` or `Accept: application/json` always returns the JSON error envelope with keys {\"error\",\"message\",\"request_id\"}. devon: Confirmed — adding `-H \"Accept: application/json\"` fixed it for me. I now get: ```json {"error":"internal_server_error","message":"worker OOM on model x","request_id":"7f9c2a"} ``` alex: Great — thanks for verifying. I've opened INF-482 and flagged it P0. @maya can you PTAL to either rollback the HTML change or push the JSON enforcement hotfix? We'll notify affected tenants. maya: I'll push the hotfix to the control plane in the next 30m to ensure behavior is consistent. Will follow up here once deployed. :eyes: incident-bot: Created issue INF-482 (json-error-enforcement) and linked to 1765001234 support-bot: Noted customer acme-apps impacted — sending outreach email template. devon: Thanks all. Please ping once it's fixed so I can remove the Accept header workaround. maya: Hotfix deployed to prod at 1765001400 UTC. Verified that when response_format=\"json\" we return the JSON error envelope even for 5xx. Regression test added. alex: Closing loop with customer and logging follow-up doc. :thumbsup: devon: Confirmed on my side — working without Accept header now. Thanks! :heart: alex: Marking thread resolved and adding notes to the status page.
